summary: The core retraction edits in the requested documents are mostly correct: the AD memo now has an explicit channel-vs-state retraction banner, the title is downgraded to Choi-state only, §2 is rewritten as an OPEN channel-level problem, the bad `log₂(3)/log₂(2)` formula is removed, the plot script/figure no longer advertise `Q ≤ K^{↔} ≤ E_R^PPT` for AD and now include the tele-covariance disclaimer, RETRACTION §8 gives a factually accurate account tied to the silent-upgrade trap, and `upper_bound_report` correctly marks AD as Choi-only while leaving dephasing/depolarizing/erasure at channel level. However, the retraction is not complete: an active generator script still prints the original invalid AD channel-level UB claim, so the round-1 critical issue persists in the repo.

issues.description: The active fill script still states `Q=0 but E_R^PPT > 0 gives nontrivial UB on K^{↔}` for anti-degradable AD. That is the same channel-level overclaim rejected in round 1: this script computes/records a Choi-state quantity, and for AD that does not automatically upper-bound channel `K^{↔}` because AD is not teleportation-covariant.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite the final status line to a Choi-state-only statement, e.g. that the sweep finds nonzero `E_R^PPT(J_N)` in the anti-degradable region while channel-level `K^{↔}` remains OPEN. If desired, also rename printed labels to make the state/channel distinction explicit.

issues.description: The memo and retraction still describe the plot/report fixes as pending 'next round', but the actual plot script/figure and `upper_bound_report §11` are already corrected in this patch. This leaves stale status tracking inside the retraction package.
issues.suggestion: Update those action/TODO lines so they distinguish completed fixes from genuinely pending work. After the fill-script cleanup, the only remaining OPEN item should be the search for a valid channel-level AD converse, not the already-applied plot/report wording changes.

round_recommendation: Fix the residual overclaim in `scripts/AD_antidegradable_E_R_PPT_fill.py`, then clean up the stale 'next round' action items in the memo/retraction text. After that, this retraction should be ready for a PASS if no other live AD channel-UB claims remain.
